About Me

Jeewoong Kim specializes in software testing and dynamic program analysis, with a focus on detecting, reproducing, and validating software bugs through automated techniques.

His research has covered real-world regression bug analysis, continuous fuzzing, and requirements-to-test traceability. He completed doctoral coursework and passed the comprehensive examination in Computer Science at Chungbuk National University (CBNU), where he conducted software engineering research at the SDEV lab with his advisor Shin Hong.

📧 jeewoong4@gmail.com
